newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto in good health - official.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto in good health - official.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto was in good health and conducting business as usual on Thursday, palace officials said, following market speculation he had been admitted to hospital.
"He is fine and is fulfilling his schedule," an official told Reuters.
The Indonesian rupiah fell to a low of 2,325 to the dollar from an early level of 2,317 before stabilising at 2,321.
Dealers said rumours on Suharto's health had been recurring since he went to Germany for a medical check up in late July where he was given a clean bill of health.
The announcement of Suharto's departure for July's check-up sent the stock market and the rupiah plunging, but they later recovered all their losses.
The rupiah quickly recovered from Thursday's weakness to trade near the upper limit of the central bank's intervention band against the dollar.
At 0842 GMT, the rupiah was trading at 2,320.50 to the dollar.
